notes.title: Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the soundtrack is available to purchase on Steam! Now you can listen to your favorite Shipwreck songs anytime you'd like for just $2.99. And if you haven't bought the game yet, you can get the Deluxe Edition for just $3.99 which includes the game and soundtrack.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/409470/

notes.title: Humble Steam Keys
notes.notes:
First we want to thank everyone who bought our game on Humble. You were our first believers and helped us spread the word of our game. We have no doubt that the Humble buyers are the reason we're on Steam now.

As we have always promised, Humble owners of Shipwreck get the Steam version for free. We have already delivered the keys to Humble who has assigned them out to customers who bought the game. To get your copy, you will need to login to your account at http://humblebundle.com to find and redeem your Steam code.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Shipwreck, 33% off!
notes.notes:
Shipwreck is Now Available on Steam and is 33% off!*

Shipwreck is a top down adventure game in which you must travel the land, explore dungeons, and defeat monsters to earn safe passage off the island on which you are stranded.

Shipwreck is the first game from Brushfire Games, a small game studio in Redmond, WA, run by brothers Nick and Joe Gravelyn.

*Offer ends February 20 at 10AM Pacific Time
